title: Database connection refused
symptoms: Database connection failed. Connection refused while opening a database connection.
root_cause: The database service was unavailable or was not listening on the configured host and port.
resolution: Verify database service health, confirm the configured host and port, and inspect database service logs.

title: Application request timeout
symptoms: Request timed out after several seconds. Requests became slow or failed to complete.
root_cause: The request may have been blocked by a slow dependency, overloaded service, or an excessive timeout configuration.
resolution: Inspect request latency and dependency health. Check resource utilization and configure timeouts based on measured service behavior.

title: Service failed to bind to port
symptoms: Address already in use. The application could not bind to its configured listening port.
root_cause: Another process may already be listening on the requested port.
resolution: Identify the process using the port, verify whether it should be running, and configure a valid listening port if needed.
source: Synthetic incident for LogLens AI testing

title: Permission denied when reading a file
symptoms: Permission denied while opening or reading a configuration or application file.
root_cause: The process may lack the filesystem permissions required to access the file.
resolution: Inspect file ownership and permissions, confirm the service account, and grant only the access required.

title: Out of memory during job execution
symptoms: Out of memory. A worker or scheduled job terminated while processing data.
root_cause: The workload may have exceeded available memory or retained more data than expected.
resolution: Inspect memory usage and job size, profile memory-intensive operations, and adjust workload limits or resources based on evidence.
